batch_size.description: Batch Size for sampling of data by {@link KerasGenerator} for the model of {@link KerasPipe}.

shuffle.description: If true, shuffle the training data.

prefetchFileCount.description:
File count for prefetching of {@link Data.Persisted} by {@link KerasGenerator} for model
training or processing.

nativeClassUrl.description: The url for accessing the saved native class source code.

title:
This type represents a Keras data generator whose functionality is implemented by a custom native Python class.
A custom native Python generator can be tied to a {@link KerasPipe} using a {@link KerasConvertSpec}, and once added,
a {@link KerasCustomGenerator} will be created to wrap around the native class. Once the {@link KerasPipe} has been
created with the custom generator, the generator will be used automatically for training and processing. Please see
{@link KerasConvertSpec#nativeGenerator} for the requirements and an example of a custom native Python
generator class.
name: KerasCustomGenerator
